children: SoundHound AI filed a prospectus supplement to register resale of Class A Common Stock issued to former LivePerson noteholders.
Prospectus supplement updates Form S-3 registration for resale of Class A Common Stock issued in LivePerson acquisition.
Shares were issued to former LivePerson noteholders to satisfy contractual registration rights under the acquisition agreement.
Legal opinion from Latham & Watkins on validity of the Common Shares is filed as Exhibit 5.1 and incorporated by reference.
